description: Run bounded body-frame velocity commands on Microduck in MuJoCo. Tested play presets: forward vx=0.4; arc turns vx=0.3,yaw_rate=±1. Actual velocity is measured and may differ; smaller commands can stall.

vx.description: Requested forward velocity in m/s. Tested play preset 0.4; smaller commands can fail to initiate or restart walking.

duration_ms.description: How long to request motion; runtime timeout must include at least 1000 ms extra for stopping.

success_description: Requested interval produced measured directional movement, completed without detected fall, then zero twist and measured settling confirmed. Coarse movement gates do not certify exact speed or distance; stalled commands fail.
